name: Isolation and Iterative Root Finding
definition: A new intersection algorithm that aims to be as fast as Neubauer's method but as correct as Schwarze's method by isolating roots via extrema before using iterative refinement.
summary: Isolation and Iterative Root Finding is a ray-voxel intersection algorithm that isolates the root interval via polynomial extrema before applying iterative refinement, balancing correctness with speed and improving numerical stability.
